A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same NI-Tex study, with all 17 pages, including Appendices A and B, available for comparison. Text and rendered pages match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original texture-generation experiments, including KID/FID results in Table 1 and baking-strategy comparisons in Appendix B.4 and Figure 10.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains the original quantitative and qualitative experiments in Section 5 and Appendix B, including Table 1 and Figure 10.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendix A retain identical architecture, augmentation, training losses, MR rectification, and uncertainty-guided iterative baking procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Objaverse, TexVerse, and BEDLAM training coverage and the same industrial meshes, Hunyuan3D-generated meshes, DeepFashion2 images, and 4D-Dress evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain Paint3D, Hyper3D OmniCraft Texture Generator, Hunyuan3D, and Meshy 6 Preview. The coverage-based baking comparator is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Training settings, preprocessing, evaluation sample counts, and KID/FID metrics are identical. Appendix B.4 retains the same ten-view selection and worst-view PSNR evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The baking-strategy analyses in Figures 5 and 10 and multiview consistency examples in Figures 13–15 are identical. No ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 5.3 specifies the same fixed set of 42 random seeds for KID experiments in both versions. Statistical and uncertainty reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are identical, including the appendix figures. Table 1 retains NI-Tex's KID of 0.0364 and FID of 237.59, alongside unchanged comparator scores.

T1.justification: The problem definitions and Equations (1)–(9), including the appendix formulations, are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about non-isometric texture generation, the garment dataset, uncertainty-aware baking, and generation quality.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Section 6 retains the same limitation concerning generalization to complex rigid deformations and insufficient simulated data for general objects.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix A retain identical implementation and data-preparation details, including training on eight H200 GPUs for about ten days. Code and dataset release statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 27 bibliography entries are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v1 dated 24 November 2025 to v2 dated 13 March 2026. Paper wording, headings, and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–15, Table 1, captions, and page layouts are identical. Rendered differences are confined to the version/date text in the first-page margin.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, implementation details, limitations, and appendix material are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
